name: stabilize
description: A floor-first AI support website with privacy-bounded account memory on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.apply:prompt-policy: node scripts/apply-4000-character-policy.mjs && node scripts/align-4000-character-tests.mjs && node scripts/apply-openai-conversations.mjs
scripts.check: npm run apply:prompt-policy && wrangler types --include-runtime false && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.test: npm run apply:prompt-policy && npm run test:node && npm run test:worker
scripts.test:node: node --test test/safety.test.mjs test/markdown.test.mjs test/terrain.test.mjs test/ui.test.mjs test/product.test.mjs test/mobile-quality.test.mjs test/domain.test.mjs test/billing.test.mjs test/feedback.test.mjs test/prompt-submit.test.mjs test/outcome-followup.test.mjs test/no-document-export.test.mjs test/sustainability.test.mjs
scripts.test:worker: vitest run --config vitest.config.js test/worker.test.mjs test/session-memory.test.mjs test/billing-account.test.mjs test/feedback-gate.test.mjs test/feedback-worker.test.mjs test/auth.test.mjs
